Container.Name: takt-registry
Container.Overview: Self-hosted TAKT fleet management, version deployment and Raspberry Pi data mirroring.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Registry web interface and Pi agent API

Config.Name: Registry data
Config.Description: SQLite metadata, releases, mirrors and online backups

Config.Name: Bootstrap admin username
Config.Description: Explicit username used only to create the first administrator

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Use a unique password of at least 16 characters

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set true only when the registry is served through HTTPS
